summary: Corteva filed an 8-K on September 25, 2026 disclosing SEC effectiveness of Vylor's Form 10 registration statement, clearing the spin-off of Vylor as an independent publicly traded company, expected to complete October 1, 2026. Record holders as of the close of business September 24, 2026 receive one Vylor share for every Corteva share. No price, premium, cash consideration, breakup fee, or advisor is stated; mechanics are a pro-rata distribution, with Form 10 details hosted on Corteva's site. Watch post-separation trading, index inclusion, and when-issued execution risk.
